body:
If you’re on the lookout for a solid course that will help you master branding—you’re in the right place!

When it comes to branding, you can find the most popular courses by browsing online education platforms for creatives like Udemy, Skillshare, Coursera, MasterClass, Domestika, CreativeLive, FutureLearn and more.

Where can I find the best courses on branding?

With so many courses on the internet, you don’t have to get a bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field anymore.

You can just master everything branding by studying online and at your own pace!

Although there are many branding courses available online, there are not many that are actually worth your time.

Branding is a very broad term that encompasses many different disciplines so it might be hard for you to decide which course is best for you.

So I’ve listed down some of the best branding courses that you can find on the internet, together with a quick review of each, so that you can pick the one that suits you best.

Now, you might be asking yourself “What if I’m a beginner at branding?”—No worries.

Many of the courses on the list below are suitable for beginners as well as for more advanced folks.

Also check out my other article where I feature 10 Best Marketing Strategy Courses Online.

What is branding

In the literal and original sense, branding was a process used to distinguish a person’s cattle from the other ones.

In today’s world, branding has expanded to the deployment of marketing and communication tools and techniques.

It basically differentiates a company or product from its competitors and helps people make their decisions fast.

The primary purpose of branding is not just to advertise and grab the customers’ attention but rather to create a lasting impression on the customer’s mind.

Brand strategy (mission, vision, core values), brand identity (logos and trademarks), brand communication (tone of voice and messaging), product design, etc., —they're all essential components of a brand's toolbox.

In this era where there are so many products are similar to each other, many believe that branding is the best method to achieve differentiation in the marketplace.‍

So, the question remains, Is it really worthy of learning professional branding from experts?—The answer is a YES, because good branding is always good for business.

So whether you're an entrepreneur trying to start your own brand, or a creative who wants to learn new skills—here's my list of top online branding courses to take in 2022.

1. Brand Design and Strategy

If you're a creative director, brand manager, or a senior designer that is looking for the best course for your professional needs, Brand Design and Strategy is perfect for you.

The best branding course for senior creatives.

This is a practical online course that covers everything you need to create brands that stand out.

From developing a strong brand strategy, story, and visual identity, to leading the team and launching the brand into the world—Brand Design and Strategy covered it all.

I can say that enrolling in this course is one of the greatest investments that senior creatives may have to be able to even level-up their skills and knowledge about branding.

You can be confident that at the end of this course, you'll understand what you need to put in place to create a successful brand strategy as well as a brand story that will connect within.

Course details:

  • Duration: 6 hours of pre-recorded video
  • Experience Level: Advanced
  • Language: English
  • Price: $1588

What you’ll learn:

  • How to build a brand story that connects.
  • How to establish a successful brand strategy.
  • How to create holistic systems.

Enroll in this course now

2. A Brand Called You

Debbie Millman is an educator, brand strategist, author, and host of the podcast Design Matters.

One of the best courses about personal branding.

She has been called "one of the most influential designers working today" by Graphic Design USA.

In this branding course, you’ll learn how to create a philosophy that will guide you throughout your career.

Join Debbie and indulge yourself in the amazing journey that she’s going to take you on.

  3. Developing a disciplined work ethic.
  4. How to sell yourself with immense confidence.

Enroll in this course now‍

‍3. Brand Management

Professor Nader Tavassoli of London Business School compares and contrasts previous branding methods to the newer ones.

A great brand workout with videos from leading experts.

The course's goal is to shift people's perceptions of brands as a visual identity (e.g., logo) and promise to customers, to brands seen more as an overall customer experience delivered by a business.

This course talks about how the perception should be shifted to an experience with "moments-that-matter" along the customer journey.

You will learn how to establish brands from a broad organizational viewpoint.

Brands aren't just a promise to customers, but a tool to execute business strategy through internal brand-led behavior and culture transformation.

Course details:

  • Duration: Approx. 17 hours
  • Experience Level: Beginner and advanced
  • Language: English with subtitles in other languages.
  • Price: $28

What you’ll learn:

  • How to build brands from a broad organizational perspective.
  • How to capture returns to brands across the organization.
  • How to measure brand health in new ways.

You’ll learn how to conduct brand-driven cultural change that prioritizes human resource practices.

This course from Coursera is totally free, plus it comes with a certificate upon completion.

4. Personal Branding

Kate Arends, the founder of Wit & Delight, leads you through a strategic lesson on how to build, evolve, and leverage your online personal brand for success.

This course is for anyone who wants to take their personal brand to the next level with a thoughtful and strategic approach.

So what’s the secret to her success?—Kate explores the evolution of her blog and explains how an authentic personal brand how propel your career.

Exclusive printable worksheets are included in the session to assist you in putting each lesson into practice.

There are PDFs that can help you figure out what makes you unique, and how to develop work goals.

They're made to be used and reused, offering you tools you can count on time and time again.

This program is a great resource whether you're just starting out in your profession, want to start a blog or a side hustle.

5. The Staples of Branding

Join streetwear pioneer Jeff Staple as he provides firsthand experience and advice for establishing a brand from purpose to product.

This program is ideal for creatives in fashion industry.

The author of this course gives vital and tactical information for entrepreneurs, fashion seekers, and anybody who wants to start their own creative product firm.

Jeff founded Staple Design in 1997 and now has a wealth of experience that may assist you in making your business a success.

In this course Jeff will also provide advice on how to go about executing your chosen path.

Danielle will walk you through the entire process of branding a company from beginning to end.

This course will teach you how to visually articulate and communicate your brand to your target audience in cohesive way across all touch-points.

Branding is all about trust and trust is built on a strong, clear message and visual consistency—which this course can help you achieve.

Learn how to define brands—from strategy to design.

In this branding course, the Saffron team and other instructors take you through the branding processes and techniques of professionals.

You will discover the examples of different types of briefs that Saffron receives from their clients and how to use them to kick off the project.

You will learn how to to uncover the most attractive opportunities and ideas for the articulation of the new brand positioning.

Then you see how Saffron brainstorms creatives ideas in order to give life to the brand in the visual field.

The team will walk you through a real case study (Tuenti rebrand) so that you can see how to put these techniques into practice.

8. Creative Branding

In this course from FutureLearn you will learn effective branding strategies from the world's most creative marketer—Burger King CMO Fernando Machado.

Learn how to develop a powerful creative strategy.

Fernando Machado is one of the most famous and decorated marketers in the world, and he was the head of design at Burger King when they teamed up with renowned agency JKR to carry off a branding project.

This is a great course if you're into studying the successful strategies of top brands—like Burger King that is.

You’ll discover the full branding process using real-world examples.

Rethink your approach to branding and marketing with this great course by foremost expert in the field.

Thanks to all great tips and advices, you can experiment more and be able to create new creative work much easier and faster than ever.

9. Contemporary Brand Identity

Michael Johnson is the founder of branding consultancy Johnson Banks, renowned worldwide for great work for clients like The University of Cambridge, UNICEF, Duolingo and more.

A great course to learn modern visual and verbal branding.

Branding is so much more than the ads or logos we see—and as Michael puts it: “Creating memorable brands is not just about designing a logo.”- Michael Johnson.

In this course, Michael Johnson doesn't only tech you design as the name would suggest, but also goes beyond visual and shows you how to combine words and design together to build unique brand identities.

Also, you'll learn how to discover the core purpose of a business which will help you create a great connection with its consumers.

Never overlook the fact that verbal branding is at times better than visual branding since it helps to make the most out of a good idea and Michael will show you how to do it.

Michael shows you his original branding tactics, backed by decades of experience to help you create your branding concept from start to finish.

PS. I also interviewed Michael on my podcast—Defining And Designing Brands with Michael Johnson

This course will show you that it is possible to build a successful brand without spending a fortune and it does so by showing you specific techniques based on real-life case studies.

Conclusions

This is my my list o 10 best branding courses and believe me, you don't have the break the bank to just go out there and shine!

Some of this courses are totally free while others are premium but very affordable.

Which of these branding courses is the best for you?

Remember, knowing and doing is the same as not knowing—so try to experiment and put this knowledge into practice right away.

Branding can be a confusing thing to many people, there's so much to learn and everyone seems to have a different process.

So I've put together a list that includes something for everyone—I hope they will help you on your journey to becoming a branding expert.

That being said, try to pick at least two or three courses and start implementing what you learn as soon as you can.

Also, if you’re interested in learning more about other subsections of branding like: brand strategy, brand naming, brand storytelling etc.—then check out my shop.
